prompt: A wooden artefact contains only one-eighth as much carbon-14 as a living tree of the same mass. Carbon-14 has a half-life of about 5,730 years. About how old is the artefact?

options.text: About 17,190 years, because one-eighth is three halvings — after 5,730, 11,460 and then 17,190 years
About 5,730 years, because one-eighth disappears in a single half-life
About 11,460 years, because one-eighth is two halvings
About 45,840 years, because one-eighth is eight halvings

explanation: Each half-life halves the carbon-14 that remains: 1 to 1/2 to 1/4 to 1/8 is three halvings. Three times 5,730 years is about 17,190 years since the wood died and stopped taking in new carbon-14.
